summary.text: Michelle Tweed is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 21, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election against Brenda Miller (R).
A U.S. Navy veteran and Colorado Springs native, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she holds degrees in criminal justice and management and is pursuing a PhD in health psychology.

paragraphs.text: Michelle Tweed graduated from Mesa Ridge High School, earned bachelor's and graduate degrees from Colorado Technical University in 2013 and 2014, and served in the U.S. Navy from 2003 to 2008; she lists her profession as management.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Tweed said she was born and raised in Colorado Springs, holds a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice and a Master of Science in Management with a homeland security concentration, and is pursuing a PhD in Health Psychology.
She said Colorado needs balanced solutions on protecting natural resources, responsible water stewardship, supporting farmers and ranchers, and smart, sustainable growth.
